about_short_description.short_description: AI Customer Service Platform for Enterprises

product.name: Typewise AI Agent Platform
product.description: An enterprise customer-service automation platform for deploying AI agents across support, sales, and commerce workflows, with omnichannel communication, system integrations, human approvals, and performance monitoring.

product.name: Typewise AI Assistant
product.description: An AI assistant for customer-service agents that supports ticket triage, knowledge-grounded reply suggestions, multilingual writing, and faster conversation wrap-up through summaries, tagging, and dispositioning.

product.name: Typewise AI SDK
product.description: A software development kit for integrating Typewise AI capabilities into enterprise applications, customer-service systems, and custom workflows.
